scope: local Linux public-development comparison, not a Kaggle or hidden-game result
action_scope: policy-issued commands including required resets; toolkit make performs the same initial RESET for every case
time_scope: decision, step, observation learning and action logging loop; initialization and scorecard closure excluded; cooperative between calls; deep-copying each returned response is included for all five policies

policy_parameters.observation: final rendered image, game state, completed levels and legal actions; no game ID, source, metadata, model or answer access
policy_parameters.candidate_pool: legal simple commands plus16coarse grid clicks, up to16nonbackground connected-component representatives and16seeded pixel samples; deduplicated and capped64
policy_parameters.control_sampling: candidate_uniform samples action type uniformly, then command; memory tie breaks balance type and command usage
policy_parameters.memory: full command outcomes including click coordinates, no-ops, deaths, loops and observed progress; max500states and500edges
policy_parameters.planner: depth2, max64edge inspections per decision, only observed single-outcome edges, replan after every observation
policy_parameters.resets: only observed NOT_PLAYED or GAME_OVER; stop at WIN or budget; no forced restart heuristic

primary_measure: local official toolkit score percent: average replicates within each game, then equal weight across25games
initial_condition_check: all frame-sequence pixels, state/levels, legal actions and win target must match across policies for each game/seed before gameplay
order: seed, manifest game order, then policy order rotated by(game_index+seed) modulo5; fresh Arcade/known scorecard per case, shared Python process
rng: Python random and NumPy legacy RNG reset before each Arcade/make; policy private seed; no claim of distinct engine variants
checkpoint: bounded corrected checkpoint: all25games and all5policies at seed0,125cases; report before further exploration
replication: none executed in this bounded phase; original v1 declaration retained separately
replay: none executed in this bounded phase; original v1 declaration retained separately
exclusions: none planned; all failures/time stops retained; incomplete or drifting batches have no valid primary mean; do not silently drop cases
interpretation: descriptive paired public-development results; no significance, novelty, competitive-readiness or unseen-game claim; no tuning grid
observation_detachment: deep-copy the complete initial observation and each returned response before policy/logging/next step; detach nested-list diagnostic images

correction.reason: six completed first actions mutated retained before-image pixels and failed the strict pending-observation check; all six diagnostic detached controls stayed stable
